attack_surface.boundary: verify-then-accept: what runs before a ref, baseline, index, policy or file is accepted from the host, and the paths a key or server address takes through the CLI

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: self-signed forgeries pass (TM-R01); other clients ignore it (A8); a vault that switched it on before 0.21 has no recorded start
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: pull and clone refuse unsigned, bad or no-key commits made since the policy was switched on (signed-since-<head>)

risk_decision.rationale: CLEARED (the direction of the failure is the safe one; documented in the register)

vulnerabilities.title: the policy start anchor is read from the server-merged index, deliberately not pinned (TM-R29/R30); when the anchor is not local, policy_start is empty and pre-policy commits between the held head and the anchor are checked (fails closed)
require_signatures returns "no policy" when the local index file is missing
